verdict.rationale: pnpm documents --frozen-lockfile behavior explicitly: install fails if the lockfile is present but needs an update, and automatically enables this mode when running in CI, giving platform engineers a reliable way to enforce lockfile/manifest agreement. This is corroborated across multiple docs pages covering install flags and CI behavior. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on community confirmation specifically of frozen-lockfile failure behavior (community evidence covers other topics only).
